answer_2.quote: We evaluate all models on the GSCh test set according to token and headline accuracy

answer_4.quote: Extracted tuples are labeled by two annotators who achieved an inter-annotator agreement rate of 90.0% before remedying discrepancies. Each extracted tuple is labeled for validity, and if invalid, the type of the salient error.
answer_4.guideline: The types of salient error include argument misattachment, incomplete argument, missing core argument, malformed predicate, and incomplete predicate.
